The native copy reference scopes by turn test IDs; do not treat numbered conversation-turn indexes as message IDs. Only explicit stable message attributes are valid.

Public parent links follow verified mapping edges through system/tool/analysis nodes. Unknown or unsupported intervening public messages invalidate projected parent identity. Repeated Markdown parts are preserved; status finished_successfully plus end_turn true required for terminal evidence.

ChatGPT readonly DOM scopes explicit stable message IDs, skips non-public message channels and strips reasoning/tool/action/status content; numbered conversation-turn containers never become IDs. Login/challenge states block send and leave the page available for manual action.

Lazy ChatGPT factory and canonical conversation URL integrated into the existing registered task service and native task UI. Shared NativeProviderSession and existing BrowserOperationQueue own input/capture/cancellation; no network replay or separate workspace.

Bilingual incomplete-history/identity explanations cover ChatGPT branch limits; MIT source headers, NOTICE and bilingual source mapping updated.
